# Prop a Prop Teu

> Barcelona (Spain) workshop and online shop for film, TV, theatre and event crews. We design and fabricate our own set-dressing tools and props (3D printing + workshop fabrication), sell the tools and materials we use every day, and take custom commissions. Trilingual site: Catalan, Spanish, English. Prices include 21% VAT. Online ordering by bank transfer (card payment coming soon).

## Shop & products
- [Tienda / Shop](https://propapropteu.com/shop.html): catalogue of custom set-dressing tools — quick picture-hangers, furniture levellers, stick-on cable clips, safety hooks, reusable position markers, clamp monitor mounts, door/flat wedges — plus workshop-made props.
- [Atrezo a medida / Custom props](https://propapropteu.com/custom-props.html): bespoke fabrication — design & prototyping, 3D printing, moulding, finishing. Request a quote.
- [Packs de producción / Production packs](https://propapropteu.com/packs.html): recurring packs of tools, consumables and materials for production sourcing teams.

## Company & info
- [Qui som / About](https://propapropteu.com/about.html): who we are and how we work.
- [Contacto / Contact](https://propapropteu.com/contact.html): info@propapropteu.com · Barcelona, España.
- [Envíos y devoluciones / Shipping & returns](https://propapropteu.com/envios.html): delivery times, payment, 14-day withdrawal, guarantee.
- [FAQ](https://propapropteu.com/faq.html): shipping, returns, VAT, custom orders, packs.

## Who it's for
Set dressers, art departments, production designers, prop makers and other film/TV/theatre/event professionals who need reliable, workshop-tested tools and bespoke props.

## Contact
Email info@propapropteu.com for orders, custom quotes or any question.
